fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of 7.5% of Gross Revenues or $1,500/month, due on the 15th of each month. Marketing Fund Contribution is the greater of 3% of Gross Revenues or $1,500/month. Local Marketing spend is tiered by private office occupancy rate: below 25% occupancy = $6,000/month minimum; 25%-50% = $4,000/month minimum; 50%-75% = $2,500/month minimum; 75%-90% = $1,500/month minimum; 90%+ = no minimum. Technology Fee is currently $2,000/month for first 4 users plus $75/month per additional user; OE may increase up to 10% annually. Procurement Service Fee is the greater of 15% of gross value of materials/services ordered on franchisee's behalf or $25,000, as incurred. Convention Fee currently $600/person paid February 28 annually (covers 2 registration fees). Renewal Fee is $2,500. Local/Regional Advertising Cooperative currently none, but may require up to 5% of Gross Revenues per month less Marketing Fund contributions. Enterprise Level Internet/Backup is $1,000-$3,000/month to third-party provider. Additional Training Fee is $500 or then-current fee. Member and Client Referral Fee is 5%-30% of membership cost/contracted value.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | The greater of 1) 7.5% of Gross Revenues or 2) $1,500 | Due on the 15th day of each month. | The "Royalty" is based on Gross Revenues during the previous month.
Marketing Fund Contribution | The greater of 1) 3% of Gross Revenues or 2) $1,500 | Same as Royalty and as incurred. | See Item 11 for more details.
Local Marketing | If your private offices occupancy rate is: (A) below 25%, you must spend at least $6,000 per month; (B) between 25% and 50%, you must spend at least $4,000 per month; (C) between 50% and 75%, you must spend at least $2,500 per month; (D) between 75% and 90%, you must spend at least $1,500 per month; or (E) at or above 90%, there is no minimum required | Monthly | Payable to a third-party vendor.
Technology Fee | Currently $2,000 per month for the first four (4) users, and an additional $75/month for each additional user after the fourth. | Same as Royalty | Payable to OE and includes workplace management software, IT Networking, CRM, Office 365 licenses, email accounts, and support software. OE reserves the right to increase this fee up to 10% annually.
Procurement Service Fee | The greater of 1) 15% of the gross value of the materials and services ordered by us or our affiliate(s) on your behalf or 2) $25,000 | As incurred | Payable to us
Convention Fee | Currently $600 per person | Paid on February 28 every calendar year | Covers 2 initial registration fees.
Renewal Fee | $2,500 | At the time you sign the new Franchise Agreement
Local and Regional Advertising Cooperatives | As determined by cooperative members; currently none. | May require 5% of Gross Revenues per month less amount paid to Marketing Fund.
Enterprise Level Internet and Backup | $1,000 to $3,000 per month | Payable monthly
Additional Training Fee | $500 or the then-current fee
Member and Client Referral Fee | 5% to 30% of membership cost/contracted value
